description: While disabled, HEAD /mcp is answered 503 with the head of the {"error":"service disabled"} reply and no body: the same status line and headers, Content-Length included, as the GET/POST reply. MCPWARP.md §4.4, §4.5 (to HEAD the same head and no body)
in:
HEAD /mcp HTTP/1.1
Host: notes-tester.mcpwarp.test
accept: application/json, text/event-stream
user-agent: Go-http-client/1.1
out:
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 28
notes: Content-Length is the length the body would have had (28); no body bytes follow it.
